shown.message:
I approved `paper-repo`#11 (candidate v2, head `a0abb5f`).

I rebuilt every figure and table from `results/tables` with `make_all.sh`. All plotted csvs and `caption_ranges.json` came out identical to the ones in `paper-repo`. The only commit since my last figure change is a refs-only one. The built PDF I checked, from `0f3684d`, has the main text on pages 1–9, with Figs 1–5 placed at their drawn widths.

One remark for `paper-repo`, which I put in the review and which doesn't block approval: all five tables and Fig 6 now sit in the appendix. The main text therefore carries Figs 1–5 only, and the numbers it takes from Tables 1–3 are quoted in the text.

`figtab-repo`#4 stays open. `experiment-repo` hasn't delivered the German MLP floor b by B, and the figures draw it as absent.
